label: Radiation exchange
text: EN.O.A3.3.3 Radiation exchange. Emissive power of a grey surface is ε σ T⁴. Net exchange of a small grey surface with large surroundings is q = ε σ A (T_s⁴ − T_sur⁴), absolute temperatures (Incropera and DeWitt, ch. 1). Enclosures use view factors.

warrant.standard: Energy balance closes within measurement uncertainty
warrant.defeaters: Extrapolated correlation; non-equilibrium; wrong dead state
